experiments.question: How should the backend's store hold booking-api@v1 G4 to G6 on PostgreSQL 17 under 20 simultaneous overlapping bookings, which booking-api@v1 values does PostgreSQL refuse, how do instants pass through node-postgres, what does a database per test file cost, and which Compose command exists under Colima?
experiments.finding: A per-room advisory lock (lock, read the earliest overlap, insert) gave one 201 and nineteen 409s naming it in 60 of 60 rounds, slowest 71 ms, no deadlock. The exclusion constraint alone sometimes settled only through 40P01 deadlocks (76/570 and 38/190 losers, up to 19 s a round; none in a third run), and re-reading then retrying after them left 18 attempts unbooked after ten retries, one round 215 s, 219 deadlocks. U+0000 in a title fails with 22021; an unpaired surrogate reads back as U+FFFD; year 0000 fails as timestamptz (22008); non-UUID text to a uuid column fails (22P02). Instants round-trip under any session zone with TZ=Asia/Kolkata; gen_random_uuid() is lower case. A database per test file costs about 36 ms. Only docker-compose 5.6.1 exists on this laptop (docker compose is unknown); up -d --wait with a pg_isready healthcheck works.

routed.text: From S16 (simple-login.backend's PRD v2 append, D4, D7, D8; pending note entry). The root scripts start PostgreSQL with `npm --prefix backend run db:up`, which runs `backend/compose.yaml` (service postgres, 127.0.0.1:55432, database meeting_rooms) through `docker compose` or, where only that exists, `docker-compose`, and returns once healthy: on the run's laptop `docker compose` is an unknown command and only docker-compose 5.6.1 is installed (hsdd/auto/experiments/booking-store-postgres/), so a root script that calls `docker compose` directly fails there. `npm --prefix backend start` needs the database up first and reads DATABASE_URL (default postgres://meeting_rooms:meeting_rooms@127.0.0.1:55432/meeting_rooms). The backend's gate and replay scripts start the database themselves and test on databases of their own, never meeting_rooms; the integration tests write to meeting_rooms unless they set DATABASE_URL. booking-api@v1 is produced by simple-login.backend.7 (confirm entry; the provisional simple-login.backend.4 is replaced). Under D7, 20 simultaneous attempts settled in under 100 ms in the experiment.

closes.note: timestamptz and the half-open rule are D6's schema and phase 6's queries; the 23P01 one-row DETAIL is moot under D7, which reads the earliest overlap under a per-room lock and keeps the re-read only as a fallback; no zone arithmetic (phase 5, phase 6); the quarter-hour check on the UTC instant and start-equal-to-now as started are phase 5's; timeZone joins the account data in phase 4; the gate runs with TZ=Asia/Kolkata and a guard test (phase 4, DEC-143).

Phase 4 extends backend/test/replay.ts for booking-api@v1: clock, given seeded directly with their ids into a test database (D8), DELETE, a 204's null body against an empty response without res.json(), a 201 whose id must match BookingId and differ from every given id, the expired token issued 30 min 1 s before clock, and each response checked against the top-level schema and its endpoint's $defs. Phase 7 replays all 35 against the real routes. Ids are gen_random_uuid(), lower case (experiment), never reused (D6).

G6 is held by D7's read under the room lock, with the 23P01/40P01 re-read as a fallback; the experiment showed the suggested re-read-and-retry path livelocking under 20-way contention (DEC-149). Phase 5 holds G1 (toISOString round trip), percent-decoded query values, the limits as instant arithmetic, code-point title length, one non-whitespace character, stored as sent, the POST and DELETE check orders, and a non-UUID id answering 404 (DEC-148); rooms and list orders are phase 5's views. produced_by is confirmed as simple-login.backend.7 (DEC-138).

Phase 4 adds timeZone to the accounts (ayu Asia/Jakarta, budi Europe/London), updates the accounts tests to the seven profile-api@v2 fields and the v2 me-ayu/me-budi bodies, and its gate replays profile-api.v2; it produces profile-api@v2 and is confirmed as a producer (DEC-137, DEC-138). simple-login.backend.3's Verification line is left as shipped history.

D4 puts the Compose file at backend/compose.yaml behind db:up (DEC-141) and tells simple-login.integration through a note entry and a consider item to H18; D8 gives each test file its own database on the same service (DEC-142); the gate and replay scripts run db:up before Vitest (DEC-143).

No appended phase serves or replays profile-api@v1: phase 4 produces profile-api@v2 and every new gate replays profile-api.v2. The header's Produces line and the shipped phases' citations of v1 stay, as S13 decided; deprecating v1 waits on Sync A's A-1 (execution plan C-1), after which reconcile's version ripple moves the copies.
